name: Executive
title: Free Retainer Invoice Template
description: A free retainer invoice template for advisory firms and senior consultants: a formal letterhead with the retainer amount and due date set as the headline.
summary: The amount due set as the headline, beneath a spaced-capital letterhead.
intro: A formal letterhead in spaced capitals, the amount due set as the headline with the date beneath it, and the retainer and any additional work itemized below.
explanation: A retainer invoice often goes to a partner or a director first and a finance team second. The first reader wants the amount and the date; the second wants the detail. This template serves both, in that order.

The business name is set in widely spaced capitals, like engraved stationery. The amount due is the headline, with the due date beneath; the invoice number, dates and engagement sit in a ruled ledger beside it, and remittance details have their own place under the client.
It suits advisory firms, law and accounting practices, fractional executives and senior consultants billing monthly or quarterly retainers.
fieldsTitle: What to put on a retainer invoice

fields.name: Engagement
fields.text: The agreement the retainer falls under, and the period: “Board advisory, Q4 2026”.

fields.name: Retainer
fields.text: One line for the period: “Board advisory retainer — October to December”, quantity 1.

fields.name: Additional work
fields.text: Anything outside the retainer, such as a workshop or a project, as separate lines.

fields.name: Expenses
fields.text: Travel and other agreed costs, at cost.

fields.name: Remittance details
fields.text: Full wire details: bank, account, routing or ABA, and SWIFT for international clients.

fields.name: Contact for queries
fields.text: Who to contact about the invoice, in the notes.

steps.title: Open the example
steps.text: Customize this invoice opens a quarterly retainer in the generator.

steps.title: The period
steps.text: Name the engagement and the period, and add the retainer as one line.

steps.title: Anything extra
steps.text: Add additional work and expenses beneath. The headline amount updates.

steps.title: Send
steps.text: Download the PDF and send it to both your contact and their accounts team.

faqs.a: An invoice for a fixed fee that secures your availability or a set amount of work for a period, usually billed at the start of each month or quarter. Work outside the retainer is billed separately.

faqs.q: When should I send a retainer invoice?
faqs.a: When your agreement says: commonly at the start of the period, so the retainer is paid in advance. Use the same day each period so the client can plan for it.

faqs.q: How do I show work beyond the retainer?
faqs.a: As separate lines under the retainer, each described, so the client sees what was included and what was extra.

faqs.q: Can I bill a retainer in advance and expenses in arrears?
faqs.a: Yes, on one invoice. Describe the retainer period ahead and the expenses with their past dates.
